rachel: quick follow-up from last night's recurrencewe need owners and dates for alert-tuning items so the same pages don't come back.

rachel: captured actions:
- reduce fanout for high-cardinality redis errors (owner: omar)
- extend dedupe window + add dedupe key (owner: li)
- add quiet-hours suppression for non-critical alerts (owner: rachel)
- update runbook + dashboard for suppressed_pages metric (owner: rachel)

omar: i'll take fanout. plan: change grouping to region+shard, exclude hosts with <0.5% contribution. will test in staging and post results.

li: i'll take dedupe window. propose 60s -> 300s for noisy rules and introduce dedupe_key=region:instance_type. will add metric dedupe_suppressed_pages.

rachel: i'll add quiet-hours 00:00-06:00 UTC for severity!=critical and update runbook with rollback steps.

alerts-bot: created ticket ONCALL-990: "alert tuning follow-up: redis fanout + dedupe" linking postmortem doc https://docs.internal/pm/2026-05-02

omar: tentative dates: staging test by EOD Wed (1779999999) then canary Thu morning.

li: canary in eu-prod for 12h on Thu 09:00 UTC (1780076400). will add auto-backout if pages >2 in 30m.

rachel: PR for quiet-hours by Thu afternoon, will request SRE review. i'll also add suppressed_pages panel to the oncall dashboard.

omar: will post staging logs and metrics here.

li: adding dashboard panels and will share screenshot.

rachel: thanks everyone, :thumbsup: if blocked tag @rachel or post in #eng-oncall.

alerts-bot: reminder set: /remind @eng-oncall to review ONCALL-990 results on 1780162800

li: ack.
